build_skybox_texture: build a SkyBox entity with a given style to create a skybox texture MJCF model
build_wall_textures: build a WallTextures entity with a given style to create 2D wall texture assets
build_floor_textures: build a FloorTextures entity with a given style to create 2D floor texture assets
review_skybox_mjcf_model: review the SkyBox mjcf_model property to inspect the generated MJCF root element
review_wall_textures_list: review the WallTextures textures property to inspect the list of 2D texture assets
